name: Pyne Road Park Campground
evidence: Esri z19 leaf-off + Clarity + NAIP at 33.0240,-85.1532: visible pads and RVs ~60-100 m from the high-water edge through woods; none seen nearer, though pines hide part of the band. County 'water's edge' prose and reviews (sites 8, 13 'lakeside') are not per-site proof; no site map found. Reviews report lake views; undated photos unclear.

name: War Hill Park Campground
evidence: Dawson County War Hill Park PDF (rev. 6/23/25), per-site specs + site map: 12 of 14 sites 'On the water' (not 3, 10), 30-50 ft campers; sites 5, 6, 9 easy water entry. Esri z19 at 34.3300,-83.9597 agrees: open gravel pads on the SE point (sites 4-9) ~15-25 m from shore, loop road inland.

name: Stone Mountain Park Campground
evidence: Campspot site map (park 3801, rotated from imagery, alignment inferred) + Esri z19 at 33.8052,-84.1270 (leaf-off): RVs on the lobe matched to lakeside Trail M (266-291, 37-62 ft) ~22-26 m from the waterline, loop road behind them, but a wooded bank in front, so no open apron: lakefront not earned, lakeview stands. Operator photos show the lake past the pad. Trails O/P not measured.

name: Ted & Tracy's RV Campground
evidence: Esri + NAIP at 33.6827,-82.6143: lane and RVs under canopy, no water visible. NHD: unnamed tributary ~70 m NW of the pin, Upton Creek ~180 m east. RoverPass/Outdoorsy 'Creekside Sites' tag and one 'lovely creek' review are leads only; operator pad photos show woods, no water; no site map found. Default down.
